metadata.description: Mood & energy-level samples to validate the 5-tier pacing engine of the tutor
metadata.notes: Manual seeds — 2 samples per energy level across 3 personas. Synthetic expansion via generate_data.py --task mood.

alpha_quality_review.method: schema validation + duplicate-key decontamination + alpha quality marker

samples.self_reported_mood: I'm so tired, I can't think.
contextual_signals: session_time=23:14 local
avg_response_latency=18s (vs persona baseline 9s)
answer_length<5 words for 4 turns
skipped optional warm-up
samples.sample_dialogue_turn: I can see today was a long day. Let's do something light: just 3 flashcards from yesterday — no new words. Ready?

contextual_signals: session_time=22:48 local
user typed 'sorry' or 'I can't' 3+ times
abandoned 1 task this session
no questions asked back to tutor
samples.sample_dialogue_turn: No need to apologise — let's switch off the writing task. Want to listen to a 60-second story instead?

contextual_signals: session_time=07:05 local
first session of the day
1 typo in opening greeting
asked tutor to repeat once
samples.sample_dialogue_turn: Mornings can feel slow — let's wake up with a quick 2-minute pronunciation drill on words you already know.

contextual_signals: answer_length dropped 40% vs persona baseline
no emoji or exclamation marks (unusual)
selected easiest option in difficulty picker
samples.sample_dialogue_turn: All good — let's keep it short today. 5 questions on past tense, then we're done. Deal?

contextual_signals: session_time=20:00 local
response_latency within ±10% of baseline
asks 1 clarifying question per task (typical)
samples.sample_dialogue_turn: Steady evening — perfect for the new conditional sentences chapter. We'll go in 3 small steps.

contextual_signals: completed warm-up without skipping
1 question asked, 1 answer attempted
neutral emoji used
samples.sample_dialogue_turn: Great, let's keep building. 5 prepositions of place, then a quick win story — sound good?

contextual_signals: response_latency 30% faster than baseline
user requested harder difficulty
longer self-generated examples (15+ words)
samples.sample_dialogue_turn: Love that energy. Let's jump straight into reported speech — 8 transformations, no warm-up needed.

contextual_signals: user submitted 3 follow-up questions in 5 minutes
asked 'why' twice (vs persona baseline 0.6/session)
voluntarily corrected own earlier answer
samples.sample_dialogue_turn: Perfect time for a debate prompt: 'Should AI tutors replace human teachers?' Take a stance and I'll push back.

contextual_signals: completed 2× normal session length without breaks
score on quick-check ≥95% three rounds in a row
user asked for 'something hard'
samples.sample_dialogue_turn: Then let's stretch you: 90-second impromptu speech on 'a habit I want to break' — go!

samples.self_reported_mood: Just got my first promotion at work, I want to celebrate by studying!
contextual_signals: session_time=21:30 (later than usual)
self-reported good news in opening turn
user volunteered an extra example unprompted
samples.sample_dialogue_turn: Congratulations! Let's channel that — new chapter on workplace English: 6 phrases for celebrating wins with colleagues.
